MarsRequestContext.description:
A MARS-key context that (partly) selects a parameter id.

This mirrors a single matcher rule from ``share/metkit/params.yaml``. Its
schema is kept **separate** from :class:`ParameterEntry` so the context
contract can evolve independently and so user-supplied context schemas can
validate against it. All fields are optional because ``params.yaml`` rules
do not always constrain every key (e.g. ``levtype`` is occasionally absent).
MarsRequestContext.title: MarsRequestContext

description:
A single entry from the ECMWF parameter database.

This model accepts the **canonical** field names only (``shortname``/``longname``). Raw API alias spellings (e.g. ``shortName``, ``name``) are NOT accepted and must be normalised to canonical keys before validation.

The JSON schema emitted from this model (and bundled as ``parameter_entry_schema.json``) mirrors this contract: it validates the canonical keys only.

table.description: GRIB parameter table the id encodes to (e.g. 128, 228)
table.title: Table

mars_request_context.description: MARS-key contexts (from params.yaml) in which this paramid appears; used to disambiguate shortname collisions
mars_request_context.title: Mars Request Context

origin_ids.description: WMO originating centre IDs associated with this parameter
origin_ids.title: Origin Ids

title: ParameterEntry
